newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Cyclone kills three in Mauritius.
newsitem.headline: Cyclone kills three in Mauritius.

text.p: Three people were killed when a cyclone crossed land near the southwest coast of the Indian Ocean island of Mauritius late on Sunday, police said on Monday.
The local Weather Services Office registered winds of up to 150 km (93 miles) per hour on Sunday afternoon as the cyclone passed some 50 km (30 miles) off the island's southwestern coast.
They said one person drowned, a second was electrocuted and a third died in a road crash caused by panic among drivers.
On Sunday, the authorities urged people to stay indoors and the majority of households were cut off from electric power.
